test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which year has highest investment in all three sectors together?
solution:
**Given:**

3 investment sectors manufacturing, services and defence

**Calculation:**

Here, investment in 3 sectors in 2004 

Manufacturing = 87.5 , Services = 120.41, Defense = 247.76

⇒ Total investment = ( 87.5 + 120.41 + 247.76) = 455.67

Investment in 3 sectors in 2005

Manufacturing = 84.45, Services = 121.47, Defense = 223.84

⇒ Total investment = ( 84.45 + 121.47 + 223.84) = 429.76

Investment in 3 sectors in 2006

Manufacturing = 81.23, Services = 187.98, Defense = 243.67

⇒Total investment = ( 81.23 + 187.98 + 243.67) = 512.88

Investment in 3 sectors in 2007

Manufacturing = 80.76, services = 205.67, Defense = 217.46

⇒ Total investment = ( 80.76 + 205.67 + 217.46) = 503.89

**Hence, in the year 2006 highest investment in all the three sectors taken together takes place.**
